content: The function SomeIpXf_ExtractProtocolHeader- Fields specified in [SWS_SomeIpXf_91001] shall check whether the value of the Protocol Version field (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00052]) is equal to the value defined by [PRS_SOMEIP_00051].  If this is not the case, E_NOT_OK shall be returned. Nei- ther messageType nor messageResult shall be modified in this case.
